steps.title: Collect marine water sample
steps.instruction: Collect water in a sterile, DNA‑free container; for scuba diving use a small hand‑pump and a punch‑balloon.

steps.title: Filter water through 0.8 µm membrane
steps.instruction: Filter 1 L–2 L of collected water using 250 mL Nalgene cellulose‑nitrate filters (0.8 µm). Connect the filter unit to a 12 V mini vacuum pump (e.g., DC12V Mini Vacuum Pump) and apply vacuum to pull water through.

steps.title: Dry filter after vacuum
steps.instruction: Using the vacuum, ensure the filter is dry; excess liquid can affect preservation and downstream DNA isolation.

steps.title: Cut and fold filter
steps.instruction: Cut the filter from its unit, removing the outer 0.5 cm with a sterile scalpel and holder; fold the filter twice using the scalpel and sterile tweezers.

steps.title: Place filter in preservation tube
steps.instruction: Insert the folded filter into a 2 mL screw‑cap tube prefilled with 400 µL preservation solution (do not use tubes incompatible with a 3D‑fuge). Shake the tube to fully soak the filter, wait 2–3 min, then shake again for a second soak. The filter is now ready for storage.

steps.title: Add Proteinase K in lab
steps.instruction: In the laboratory, add 20 µL Proteinase K to the preservation tube.

steps.title: Perform kit‑based DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Because the tube contains 400 µL liquid, double the standard kit reagents: add 400 µL Buffer AL and vortex thoroughly; add 400 µL ethanol and vortex; load the mixture onto a spin column. Incubate 10–30 min at 55 °C (or 56 °C). Add one volume of the kit’s genomic extraction buffer, vortex, and load onto a spin column again. Elute DNA in 200 µL AE buffer (or use 50 µL for higher concentration).

steps.title: Phenol‑chloroform DNA extraction
steps.instruction: Add 30 µL Proteinase K and incubate 30 min–2 h at 56–60 °C with regular vortexing. Add one volume of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (PCI) (2–3 mL); vortex ~2 min; centrifuge 10 min at appropriate speed; collect the aqueous (pink/red) phase. Perform a second extraction with 2–3 mL chloroform/isoamyl alcohol, centrifuge 10 min, and collect the aqueous phase (~2–3 mL). Add 500 µL 3 M sodium acetate, invert for 5 min. Add 7 mL cold ethanol, allow precipitation; centrifuge 15 min. Wash pellet twice with 3 mL 70 % ethanol, air‑dry, and resuspend in 100–200 µL nuclease‑free water, TE (T10E1) or EB.

steps.title: Process large‑volume filters
steps.instruction: For 500 mL filter units, cut the filter into four equal pieces; process two pieces immediately and store the other two in Longmire solution for later. If filter volume is <1 mL, perform extraction in the 2 mL tube; if >1 mL, transfer to a 15 mL Falcon tube (optional: add sterile 4 mm glass beads).
